TSVSP.Settings.Table.Name: Spell table on stat blocks
TSVSP.Settings.Table.Hint: List a creature's spells in a table with a cast button, uses, range, save or attack and area. Turn this off to go back to Black Flag's plain list.
TSVSP.Settings.Links.Name: Spell names in traits are links
TSVSP.Settings.Links.Hint: Every spell named in a Spellcasting trait becomes clickable: a spell the creature has opens its description, one it does not have opens the window for adding it.
TSVSP.Settings.Search.Name: Web search wording
TSVSP.Settings.Search.Hint: Added after the spell's name when you press Search the web. Example: "Phantasmal Force ToV Tales of the Valiant".
TSVSP.Settings.SearchUrl.Name: Search address
TSVSP.Settings.SearchUrl.Hint: Where Search the web goes. {q} is replaced by the words being searched for.
TSVSP.Add.Title: Add a spell
TSVSP.Add.Name: Spell
TSVSP.Add.Found: {n} found. Pick one to see it.
TSVSP.Add.None: Not in any of your spell compendiums. Search the web for its text, then add it by hand or with the importer.
TSVSP.Add.Pick: Pick a spell from the list first.
TSVSP.Add.Updated: {name} already there - its uses were set instead.
TSVSP.Add.NoPermission: {name} is not set up yet. Ask your Game Master to add it.
TSVSP.Add.SetDC: Spell save DC set to {dc} from the creature's own trait.
TSVSP.Settings.Zoom.Name: Ctrl + Scroll to zoom a window
TSVSP.Settings.Zoom.Hint: Hold Ctrl and scroll over any window to make its contents bigger or smaller; Ctrl + 0 puts it back. Each kind of window remembers its own level.
TSVSP.Settings.Sideways.Name: Wheel scrolls sideways in side-by-side lists
TSVSP.Settings.Sideways.Hint: In a window whose contents are laid out in a row and scroll sideways - Black Flag's Select Class window, for one - the wheel moves it left and right. Hold Shift for up and down. Windows that only scroll up and down are unaffected.
TSVSP.GM.Title: Cast Spell
TSVSP.GM.Pick: Pick a spell from the list first.
TSVSP.GM.NoCaster: No caster was chosen, so there is nothing to cast from.
TSVSP.GM.StandInAsk: Black Flag can only cast a spell from an actor. This makes one hidden NPC named "Spell Source", which players cannot see, for spells that come from a trap, a rune or the world itself. It is made once and reused.
TSVSP.GM.Free: Cast at will - no slot, no uses, nothing added to the stat block.
TSVSP.GM.Cleared: Removed {n} spell(s) the spellbook had added.
TSVSP.GM.Kept: The spell is added to the creature at will — no slot, no uses. Leave Save DC and Spell attack blank to use the caster's own. Sweep the added spells up with “Remove spells I added”.
TSVSP.Table.InfoTooltip: Show this spell's description, with buttons to cast it or open its full sheet.
TSVSP.Table.AddTooltip: Find a spell in the compendiums (or paste its text) and add it to this character.
TSVSP.Table.SpellTip: Click a name to read the spell.
TSVSP.Table.TypeTip: How long it takes to cast: action, bonus action, reaction, or longer.
TSVSP.Table.UsesTip: How often it can be cast: from spell slots, at will, or a set number of times per rest.
TSVSP.Table.RangeTip: How far away the spell can reach.
TSVSP.Table.RollTip: The save targets make, or the attack bonus, when the spell is cast.
TSVSP.Table.AreaTip: The shape and size of the area it affects, if any.
TSVSP.Add.SearchTooltip: Search the web for the selected spell's name - for spells the compendiums don't have.
TSVSP.Add.PasteHint: Copy the whole spell from a PDF or web page - name, circle line, Casting Time, Range, Components, Duration and description - and paste it here. It becomes a working spell with its attack, save or damage set up. You can also paste or drop a picture of the spell (a screenshot cropped to just that spell): its text is read into the box - check it, especially the numbers.
TSVSP.Add.PastePlaceholder:
Fireball
3rd-Circle Arcane (Evocation)
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 150 feet
...
TSVSP.Add.PasteSource: Magic source if the text has none (5E spells)
TSVSP.ResolutionHideSetting.Name: Hide the "window too small" warning
TSVSP.ResolutionHideSetting.Hint: Foundry warns when the browser window is smaller than 1024 x 768. Ticked, this browser stops showing that warning. Untick it to see the warning again.
TSVSP.SpellBooks.Name: Spells to choose from
TSVSP.SpellBooks.Hint: When learning spells: every book in this world, only the core books (Black Flag and the Tales of the Valiant Player's Guides), or only the other books. Also switchable in the spell window itself.
TSVSP.SpellList.Name: Spell list
TSVSP.SpellList.Label: Choose which spells players see
TSVSP.SpellList.Hint: Hide spells from the learn-spells window (they stay in the compendiums). Spells the importer thinks are weak are flagged.
TSVSP.HideDupes.Name: Hide duplicate spells
TSVSP.HideDupes.Hint: A spell that is in more than one compendium is listed once in the compendium search, the compendium windows and link suggestions (this world's own copy first, then Black Flag's). Untick to see every copy.
TSVSP.HideDupes.Note: Hidden here: {n}, because another compendium has the same spell (setting: Hide duplicate spells)
TSVSP.Picker.UsableTip: Options whose prerequisites this character doesn't meet can't be chosen
